'''Sarven''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] of the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]], he was selected as a test subject for [[Ryler Dorant]]'s work on weaponizing the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|rakghoul plague]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. Dorant infected Sarven with the plague, turning him into a [[rakghoul]]. Under Dorant's control, he was ordered alongside [[Vorzoth]] to kill [[Havoc Squad]], but was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in battle.
